meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成 GitHub PR 的代码讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要向同事或客户解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub PR into a code-change explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes to non-technical stakeholders

howto.what: 装上后,当用户提供一个 GitHub pull request(URL、owner/repo#N 或当前仓库里的“this PR”),Claude 会获取该 PR 的 diff、提交与文件信息,规划故事板与脚本,并逐帧生成一段代码变更解说视频(例如 changelog、功能展示、修复讲解或重构导览)。
howto.when: 当用户给出 PR 的 URL、owner/repo#N,或在已检出仓库中说“this PR”,要求把代码变更做成视频时触发。不用于产品宣传或非 PR 主题解说;不确定时转 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给 owner/repo#42 做一个 fix 类型的视频
say.note: 按修复讲解类型规划故事板与脚本。

say.text: 为我当前仓库里的这个 PR 做 changelog 视频
say.note: 需要已检出仓库且 PR 可用。

howto.what_en: On a given GitHub pull request (URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo), Claude fetches its diff, commits, and files, then plans storyboard/script and builds a code-change explainer video frame by frame (changelog, feature reveal, fix, refactor).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or say 'this PR' in a checked-out repo and ask to turn the code change into a video. Not for product promos or non-PR topics; route unclear cases via /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make an explainer video for this PR: https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123
say_en.note: It fetches the PR diff and starts building.

say_en.text: Create a fix-type video for owner/repo#42
say_en.note: Plans storyboard/script as a fix explainer.

say_en.text: Make a changelog video for the current PR in this repo
say_en.note: Requires a checked-out repo with an available PR.
